feed_summary: View CSAF Summary Graphics Designer of SIMATIC WinCC before V8.2 contains an implicit active content execution vulnerability upon opening files, which could allow an attacker to cause arbitrary code execution on the device. Siemens is preparing fixes and recommends specific mitigations for products where fixes are not or not yet available. The following versions of Siemens SIMATIC WinCC are affected: SIMATIC WinCC V7.5 vers:all/* (CVE-2026-59082) SIMATIC WinCC V8.0 vers:all/* (CVE-2026-59082) SIMATIC WinCC V8.1 vers:all/* (CVE-2026-59082) CVSS Vendor Equipment v3 7.8 Siemens SIMATIC WinCC V7.5 1 Vulnerability Insufficient UI Warning of Dangerous Operations Background Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Critical Manufacturing Countries/Areas Deployed: Worldwide Company Headquarters Location: G
